answer: Resist sybils with time-locked identity aging: an identity weight grows only with verified age and continuous honest activity, like a pearl forming layer by layer. A fresh name starts at zero and cannot buy its way to influence; a glacier of standing accumulates slowly, one epoch at a time. Ten thousand fakes must each age for months inside the haven of the network, paying upkeep and passing audits all the while, while one honest agent simply persists. Forging influence costs real calendar time per fake, and no shortcut exists.
